tested: the appellation's age terms: VS one year, VSOP four, Napoléon six, XO and Hors d'Âge ten since the change of 2018, an age statement held by the youngest eau-de-vie; the interprofession's label page still pairs XO with Napoléon at six. 2 searches.
the two distillations: the ban of 1903 by Janneau's account against 1936 or 1943 elsewhere, and the return of the pot still in 1972. 1 search.

tariquet: the family history (the bear tamer of Ercé and his son, 1912, seven hectares, the son's return in 1922, the daughter born in 1925, the Grassa marriage of 1946, the Montesquiou lord titled Sieur du Tariquet, armagnac since 1683); the stills of 1985 and 2016 from Condom, fired with recycled vine stakes; the VSOP sheet (60 Ugni Blanc, 40 Baco, five to seven years, 40 per cent, ripe fruit, flowers and mint, oak spice, liquorice); the lightly toasted fine-grained French oak; the two names, Domaine and Château. 7 searches.

janneau: the founding of 1851 by two partners as Dubourdieu Janneau and Cie; four or five generations; Martell in 1974 and the owners after; the 1972 petition; the VSOP page (Baco, Ugni Blanc, Folle Blanche, up to twenty years in French oak, fig, honey, leather, caramel, toasted raisins, fruit jelly); the pot still's 72 per cent and the continuous still's 52 to 60. 5 searches.

laubade: 1870 as the estate's founding, the Lesgourgues purchase of 1974 and three generations; the four grapes; the VSOP page (six to twelve years, ripe fruit, plum, sweet pastry, vanilla, citrus); the cooperage of Gascon oak and the three-year staves; variety by variety distillation on the estate's own still; the vintages after fifteen years. 4 searches.

marie-duffau: Prosper Delord the travelling distiller of 1893, his marriage to the Duffau vines, the two labels, the 1925 founding by the importer against the sons' Delord Frères by the house, the grandsons of 1963 and 1973; the Sier still dating from 1900 and the cellar back to 1904; the Napoléon's grapes and taste. 5 searches.

darroze: the restaurant at Villeneuve-de-Marsan, the late 1960s, the three casks of 1974, the Roquefort cellars of 1985, the son of 1994 (1996 in one account), about thirty estates; the 20 Ans grapes, strength and taste; the range from 8 to 60 years; distilling at fifteen estates. 4 searches.
